criteria.title: Saved organization drafts

intent.request: Implement the user-selected DAO launch checklist interface C

criteria.model: Users create and select organization drafts. Purpose, founders, step owners and configuration persist per workspace through reloads. Fresh drafts have no invented completed steps or treasury balance.
criteria.bar: Users create and select organization drafts. Purpose, founders, step owners and configuration persist per workspace through reloads. Fresh drafts have no invented completed steps or treasury balance.
criteria.method: Read Decisions D-002/D-003. Run the bound files. Inspect store cases 'preserves unrelated onboarding state and refuses cross-workspace draft access' and 'accepts one concurrent revision and rejects the stale edit'; model case 'starts with one genuine founding record and no invented approvals or balance'. Native run verify-tauri-headless/20261008T175606Z-2239423 uses committed backend c889625bec27718ef9ba8750115d009b812f1968. Read .papercusp/artifacts/dao-launch-implementation-2026-10-08/final-native-backend-source-receipt.json and final-native-assertions.sh; source and native evidence are distinct from production deployment. Native create/edit/reload must preserve selected organization, governance75%, responsible person and unknown treasury. Rate pass only for saved draft fields within the correct workspace, with no invented completion or balance; mocked component tests and preflight refusals alone are insufficient.
criteria.driftMarkers: (1) A draft is readable or writable across workspaces. (2) A saved draft field is absent after reload. (3) A fresh draft displays an invented completed stage or treasury balance. The model is the pass floor; every numbered marker is also rated.

criteria.title: Governance and funding

intent.request: Implement the user-selected DAO launch checklist interface C

criteria.model: Editable panels validate quorum, approval, voting window, delegation and revenue shares; reuse plan-admission and commercial organization types. Distinguish each organization's revenue agreement from Papercusp's 10% identity-markup allocation.
criteria.bar: Editable panels validate quorum, approval, voting window, delegation and revenue shares; reuse plan-admission and commercial organization types. Distinguish each organization's revenue agreement from Papercusp's 10% identity-markup allocation.
criteria.method: Run bound model and workspace tests. Inspect 'rejects contradictory numeric rules and duplicate signer identities', 'requires a revenue agreement and an eligible ownership register', 'calculates integer-cent examples with conserved amounts', and workspace 'keeps invalid funding edits renderable'. Read actual dao-launch.ts imports and the 1000bps literal; verify commercial OrgRole and plan-admission reuse without assuming an identity-markup constant is imported. The separate Papercusp 10% identity-markup allocation is presented in the funding panel and must not be confused with the editable organization revenue agreement. Native run verify-tauri-headless/20261008T175606Z-2239423 uses committed backend c889625bec27718ef9ba8750115d009b812f1968. Read .papercusp/artifacts/dao-launch-implementation-2026-10-08/final-native-backend-source-receipt.json and final-native-assertions.sh; source and native evidence are distinct from production deployment. Rate from numeric validation, conserved examples, separate agreement/markup presentation and native governance edit/save/reload, not just the existence of panel code.
criteria.driftMarkers: (1) An out-of-range quorum, approval, voting window, delegation or revenue share is accepted. (2) Integer-cent examples fail to conserve the amount. (3) The organization agreement and Papercusp identity markup are presented as one figure. The model is the pass floor; every numbered marker is also rated.

criteria.title: Legal and banking preparation

intent.request: Implement the user-selected DAO launch checklist interface C

criteria.model: Support existing/new entity routes, jurisdiction, document/review references, bank/provider preparation and Safe signer information. Saving a draft cannot claim legal formation, verified bank approval, adopted governance or money movement.
criteria.bar: Support existing/new entity routes, jurisdiction, document/review references, bank/provider preparation and Safe signer information. Saving a draft cannot claim legal formation, verified bank approval, adopted governance or money movement.
criteria.method: Read Decision D-002. Run bound model/API tests, including 'binds review to an exact version and never enables funding through preparation', 'keeps prepared banking waiting on legal preparation', 'uses the current authenticated person for the founder' and 'returns unavailable for a draft outside the current workspace'. For jurisdiction and legal route, dao-launch.test.ts has the existing/US fixture and an exact-version review with all five stages prepared; dao-launch-store.test.ts has the new/US fixture and persistence/review invalidation assertions. The native half additionally requires current-build set/save/reload/reopen evidence for both routes: inspect legal-native-new-panel.png, legal-native-existing-panel.png, matching legal-native-new.json and legal-native-existing.json, legal-native-assertions.sh and legal-native-backend-source-receipt.json under .papercusp/artifacts/dao-launch-implementation-2026-10-08/. The maintained script sets new/CA and existing/US, verifies the legal panel title and country after reload, and verifies route/country/entity fields on reopen. Actual native run20261009T055010Z-1067253 and child20261009T060041Z-1690800 passed preparation, boot and assertions at d32825606bbe28956c6cdf4f347d6ea981082f2a, a verified descendant of c889625bec27718ef9ba8750115d009b812f1968. Read legal-native-proof.json, legal-native-parent-result.json and legal-native-assert-result.json for the recorded full verdict and per-file digests; legal-native-guard-tests.log is separate preflight proof (20951546, eight tests, no skips). The four backend acceptance inputs dao-launch.ts, dao-launch-store.ts and desktop routes dao-launch.ts/setup-wizard-state.ts have the same recorded digests as the original c889625 receipt. Rate fail if either route's actual save/reload/reopen capture or its matching source receipt is absent. An older backend receipt alone is not a legal-panel capture. Rate legal/banking preparation and actual provider/on-chain approvals separately.
criteria.driftMarkers: (1) Saving draft preparation claims legal formation, bank approval, enacted governance or moved funds. (2) Banking preparation reports prepared before legal preparation. (3) A client-supplied review field is persisted as authoritative. (4) A legal route, jurisdiction or entity value is lost on save/reload or not rendered in the legal panel. The model is the pass floor; every numbered marker is also rated.

criteria.title: Concept C desktop interface

intent.request: Implement the user-selected DAO launch checklist interface C

criteria.model: Expose an organization sidebar, readiness summary, five checklist stages, responsible people, next action and details. Handle empty/loading/error/saving states, URL selections, desktop/mobile and app themes.
criteria.bar: Expose an organization sidebar, readiness summary, five checklist stages, responsible people, next action and details. Handle empty/loading/error/saving states, URL selections, desktop/mobile and app themes.
criteria.method: Run bound workspace tests for empty state, retry/error, editable percentages, editor cancel/reopen and stale-write protection. Compare .papercusp/artifacts/dao-launch-implementation-2026-10-08/final-native-checklist.png with ../dao-interface-mockups-2026-10-08/03-launch-checklist.png for sidebar, summary, five rows and next-action cards; this is a manual visual comparison. Read final-native-layout.json and final-native-negative-control.json (missing selector must fail), and the immutable native assertions for actual containing-width and560px checks. Native reload must preserve organization selection in the URL. Inspect theme-native-portal-light.png and theme-native-portal-dark.png plus matching JSON receipts and theme-native-assertions.sh from run20261008T200412Z-826288, backend f387766a4fe1d4d098059c38a9057918399cfd1e. The real picker and reload behavior are required; a forced560px pane is container responsiveness, not a mobile-viewport measurement. Missing theme-toggle/reload evidence cannot rate pass. Mocked nuqs/Modal/Select tests cannot prove URL or rendered theme behavior.
criteria.driftMarkers: (1) Empty, loading, error or saving state is rendered as healthy. (2) Organization selection is lost on reload or absent from the URL. (3) The560px containing pane overflows or a required C sidebar, summary, checklist row or next-action card is absent. (4) A supported theme renders the workspace unreadable. The model is the pass floor; every numbered marker is also rated.

criteria.title: Honest readiness and verification

intent.request: Implement the user-selected DAO launch checklist interface C

criteria.model: Derive readiness from stored records and approvals, preserving legal, signer and mainnet gates. Suite tests cover validation, workspace/concurrent updates and dependency-driven readiness. Verify create/edit/reload in an isolated native desktop. Do not file entities, open accounts, send external invitations or move capital.
criteria.bar: Derive readiness from stored records and approvals, preserving legal, signer and mainnet gates. Suite tests cover validation, workspace/concurrent updates and dependency-driven readiness. Verify create/edit/reload in an isolated native desktop. Do not file entities, open accounts, send external invitations or move capital.
criteria.method: Read Decisions D-002/D-003. Run bound tests: store 'blocks premature review and invalidates exact-version review after a later edit' and both setup-wizard-state atomic merge cases. Native run verify-tauri-headless/20261008T175606Z-2239423 uses committed backend c889625bec27718ef9ba8750115d009b812f1968. Read .papercusp/artifacts/dao-launch-implementation-2026-10-08/final-native-backend-source-receipt.json and final-native-assertions.sh; source and native evidence are distinct from production deployment. Read .papercusp/artifacts/dao-launch-implementation-2026-10-08/mutation-proof.json and preserved mutant logs (11 executable copy-out mutants caught with original source intact) as falsifiability controls. Inspect scripts/tauri-surface-verify-dao-launch.sh isolated-DB guard and real create/edit/save/reload assertions. For the no-external-actions clause, read dao-launch.ts, dao-launch-store.ts and the authenticated desktop route for filing/account/invitation/transfer side effects; a test passing alone does not establish absence. Rate derived readiness, exact-version review/concurrency, native verification and side-effect scope from these respective observations.
criteria.driftMarkers: (1) Derived readiness reports a stage ready without its stored record or required approval. (2) A concurrent edit is lost or later edits preserve an obsolete version review. (3) The native create/edit/reload proof is absent or mismatched to its recorded backend/SPA inputs. (4) Any external filing, account-opening, invitation or capital-transfer call exists. The model is the pass floor; every numbered marker is also rated.
